text: I haven't really noticed any wheezing or chest tightness, though I do feel short of breath when I work hard. speaker: Doctor
text: I understand your concern, but "sepsis" is a severe complication of an infection, not a specific lung disease itself, and I cannot finalize a diagnosis without ruling out other causes. speaker: Measurement
